visualCharacteristics.purpose: teaser cards linking to guide/article pages

contentPattern.structure: one row per card: optional image cell | body cell (optional icon image, short eyebrow tag paragraph, heading, text, link/button paragraphs)

usage.when: grids of linked teaser cards (legal links, calculators, news, offers, support tiles)

reuseGuidance: Pick the option matching the card chrome: plan (image over bordered body), orange-shadow (news tiles), location (heading band + details), cta-panel (stacked full-width buttons), offers (icon badge on top bar), image-orange-light / image-cyan-orange-light / cyan-image (centred icon cards).
